zones.name: Welcome & Directory
zones.blurb: Start at the directory screen. The concierge desk handles repairs, collections and returns.

zones.name: Kids Corner
zones.blurb: Flexible TR90 frames sized for ages 3 to 12, plus UV400 sunglasses for small faces.

zones.name: Men’s Collection
zones.blurb: Twelve styles across three bays: titanium and steel, everyday acetate, then rounds and browlines.

zones.name: Sunglasses Island
zones.blurb: UV400 sunglasses on a two-tier island. Most styles have polarised lenses, and any pair can take your prescription.

zones.name: Contact Lenses & Care
zones.blurb: Daily, monthly, toric and coloured lenses, with solutions, drops and cases.

zones.name: Atelier Premium Gallery
zones.blurb: Lit vitrines hold the Atelier pieces: beta titanium, 18K plating and hand-polished acetate.

zones.name: Eye Test Room
zones.blurb: A free 20-minute eye test with an optometrist. You leave with your prescription.

zones.name: Lens Bar
zones.blurb: Compare lens types, coatings and thickness before you choose. Ask for a blue-cut or photochromic demo.

zones.name: Women’s Collection
zones.blurb: Cat-eye, round and oversized frames in tortoise, crystal and fine metal.

zones.name: Fitting & Checkout
zones.blurb: Every frame gets a free fitting here. Review your bag and pay at the counter or online.

tourText.welcome: This is the entrance. The directory screen on your left maps every section, and the concierge desk handles repairs and collections.
tourText.kids: Kids’ frames are flexible TR90, sized for ages 3 to 12. The low shelf keeps them at a child’s eye level.
tourText.men: Three bays, arranged by material: titanium and steel, everyday acetate, then rounds and browlines. Tap any frame for sizes and lens options.
tourText.sun: Every pair blocks UV up to 400 nm (UV400). Most have polarised lenses, and any style can be made to your prescription.
tourText.contacts: Daily, monthly, toric and coloured lenses, plus solutions and drops. A contact lens prescription is needed at checkout.
tourText.premium: The Atelier collection sits in lit vitrines: beta titanium with 18K plating, and acetate polished by hand.
tourText.eyetest: Free 20-minute eye tests with an optometrist. The chart uses metric Snellen lines, from 6/60 down to 6/5.
tourText.lensbar: Compare lens types, coatings and thickness here. A higher index gives a thinner lens for the same power.
tourText.women: Cat-eye, round and oversized shapes in tortoise, crystal and fine metal.
tourText.checkout: Frames get a free fitting at the counter. Your bag and checkout are one tap away.
